name: mnemuron
description: Start, preview, and continue tasks across ChatGPT devices with provenance-aware memory.

interface.shortDescription: Start and continue tasks across agents
interface.longDescription: Mnemuron captures task activity with device and agent provenance, explicitly bootstraps new Projects and Canonical Tasks, previews resumable state, and only returns a Resume Packet after explicit confirmation.
